Locations.Name: Brookhaven Grid
Locations.Description: The main city where players reside

Locations.Name: Hidden Bunker
Locations.Description: A secret underground location beneath the city, protected by laser beams and a mysterious code. The bunker is alive — its code rewrites itself in real-time and lasers shift formation. It decides whether intruders leave with power or become its next guardian.

Characters.Name: Brave Survivor
Goals: Escape with power or accept guardianship

Relationships.The Entity: Watched by the silent guardian of vanished players; the entity observed the Survivor's obby run and witnessed their arrival at the fruit

Characters.Name: The Entity
Traits: Woven from static and whispered usernames
Goals: Decide fate of those who reach the chamber

Relationships.Brave Survivor: Watched the Survivor complete the obby and reach the fruit; whispered chorus crescendoed at final jump
Relationships.Vanished Players: Composed of the whispered usernames of those who vanished before

Objects.Name: Awakened Fruit
Objects.Description: A powerful, ancient fruit with unknown abilities. Glows faintly at the bunker chamber's center, casting long shadows across the obby. Within reach after completing the deadly obstacle course.

Objects.Name: Laser Beams
Objects.Description: Shifting beams that guard the hidden bunker. Crimson tripwires that slice the darkness. Can shift formation in real-time as the bunker's defenses adapt.

Objects.Name: Mysterious Code
Objects.Description: A code that protects the hidden bunker, unable to be cracked by any known means. Etched into ancient concrete, pulsing with rhythm. Rewrites itself in real-time as the bunker decides an intruder's fate.

Objects.Name: Obby
Objects.Description: A challenging obstacle course within the bunker. Features deadly platforms suspended over a void. Requires precision jumping and agility as the only weapon against the abyss beneath. The final jump brings the player within reach of the awakened fruit.
